lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Ah.”

lines.japanese: 永らく天を仰いでいた先代が、ぽつりと声を漏らした。
lines.english: The former king, who had spent so long gazing heavenward, let out a small sound.

lines.japanese: 空ではない空を、流星が尾を曳いて堕ちてゆく。
lines.english: A meteor drew its tail as it fell through a sky that was no sky.

lines.japanese: 私は笑った。
lines.english: I laughed.

lines.japanese: 「これはしたり、泣き虫ホークが逃げだしおったか」
lines.english: “Well now. Has crybaby Hawk fled?”

lines.japanese: 「はー」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 先代は首を後ろに倒したまま無感動につぶやいた。
lines.english: The former king murmured without interest, his head still tipped back.

lines.japanese: 我々はふたり来る日も来る日も頭上を眺めていた。奈落を脱したとはいえ、遥か高みの光射す園はいまだ私たちの手には遠かったのだ。
lines.english: Day after day, the two of us had watched the reaches overhead. Though we had escaped the Abyss, the garden far above us, bathed in light, remained beyond our grasp.

lines.japanese: 「ねー、じゃあホークはここに来んのかな？」
lines.english: “Hey, does that mean Hawk's coming here?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、どうやら……」
lines.english: “No. It would appear...”

lines.japanese: 先代の無邪気な問いを受けて、私は愚弟の≪精髄≫が向かった先を観測した。
lines.english: At the former king's innocent question, I observed the destination of my foolish brother's *essence*.

lines.japanese: 「ふぬん、彼はまやかしのグレタガルドへ向かうようですな」
lines.english: “Hrm. It seems he is bound for the false Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルド？」
lines.english: “Gretagard?”

lines.japanese: 「哀れですな。彼は奈落の魔性が生みだした幻覚とも知らず、自らの夢の中でかの国の救世主を気取っておるのです」
lines.english: “Pitiful creature. He does not know that land is a phantasm conjured by the Abyss. Within his own dream, he plays at being its savior.”

lines.japanese: 「あーそっかー。あいつもまだグレタガルドごっこが続いてると思ってんだなー」
lines.english: “Oh, right. So he still thinks we're playing Gretagard too.”

lines.japanese: あいつも……とは他に何者を指してのことやら分からぬが、幼い先代がときおり頓痴気な妄言を吐くのにはもう慣れていたので、私はそれを耳に入らぬ雑音として処理した。
lines.english: Whom he meant by *him too*, I could not say. But I was long accustomed to the childish former king's occasional nonsensical ravings, so I filtered the remark out as meaningless noise.

lines.japanese: 「さて、これでようやく二人目の脱落者だ」
lines.english: “At last, that makes two dropouts.”

lines.japanese: 私は≪待機室≫の扉を振りかえる。その奥には、ホークよりも先に王座を放棄して戻ってきた、暗黒街のドブネズミが篭っているのだ。
lines.english: I looked back at the door to the *Waiting Room*. Behind it, the gutter rat of the underworld who had surrendered the throne before Hawk remained shut away.

lines.japanese: 「ファルコン、出てくればいいのに……」
lines.english: “Falcon oughta come out...”

lines.japanese: 先代が私の視線を追って口を尖らせる。
lines.english: The former king followed my gaze and pouted.

lines.japanese: 「なんかケン兄がいなくなっちゃったあとのユキ姉みたい。ショボくれてへやから一歩も出ないーくて、どんどん細っこくなっちってん」
lines.english: “He's like Yuki after Ken went away. Moping around, never coming outta his room, getting skinnier and skinnier.”

lines.japanese: 「いずれ消えゆく身なれば、最期は静かに逝かせてやればよいのです。彼は私とくつわを並べるのが気に入らんようですしな。我らの知ったことではない」
lines.english: “He is destined to disappear soon regardless. Let him pass his final hours in peace. He appears to dislike riding alongside me, and it is no concern of ours.”

lines.japanese: 「上はあとイーグルだけンなっちゃったね」
lines.english: “So Eagle's the only one left up there now.”

lines.japanese: 「然り。残り一匹だ」
lines.english: “Indeed. One creature remains.”

lines.japanese: もはやそれが誰であろうと問題ではない。単身で私の呪詛に抗いきれるはずはないのだから。
lines.english: It no longer mattered who that creature was. Alone, he could never withstand my curse.

lines.japanese: すなわち、玉座が明けわたされるのは時間の問題だ。
lines.english: Thus it was only a matter of time before the throne stood vacant.

lines.japanese: 「なー、いまイーグル何してんのかなー」
lines.english: “Hey, wonder what Eagle's doing right now.”

lines.japanese: 「ふむん、様子を窺ってごらんにいれましょうか」
lines.english: “Hmm. Shall I look in upon him for you?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、見れんの」
lines.english: “What? You can see him?”

lines.japanese: 「もはや奈落ではない。ここならば私の≪世界の目≫が機能します」
lines.english: “We are no longer in the Abyss. Here, my *Eye of the World* will function.”

lines.japanese: 「おー！　なんか知んないけどスゲエぞかるら」
lines.english: “Whoa! Dunno what that means, but that's amazing, Karura.”

lines.japanese: 「では失礼……」
lines.english: “Then, with your leave...”

lines.japanese: 私はその場で仮初めの外殻から≪精髄≫を解きはなち、みずからを≪小宇宙≫へ溶けこませた。
lines.english: I freed my *essence* from its temporary shell and dissolved myself into the *microcosm*.

lines.japanese: 宇宙そのものである私は大脳皮質へ侵入し、イーグルが感覚受容器を経て外界から得た情報を傍受した。
lines.english: As the cosmos itself, I entered the cerebral cortex and intercepted the information Eagle's sensory receptors gathered from the outer world.

lines.japanese: 「あれぇー？　かるら、どこ行ったん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Karura, where'd you go?”

lines.japanese: 「そばにおりますぞ、陛下。全体と調和したに過ぎません。いわば空気そのものだとお考えください」
lines.english: “I remain beside you, Your Majesty. I have merely entered into harmony with the whole. Think of me as the very air around you.”

lines.japanese: 「はー、よく分かんないけど、ここにいるんならいいや」
lines.english: “Huh. Don't really get it, but if you're still here, that's fine.”

lines.japanese: 「……ぬ、あやつは」
lines.english: “...Hm? That one...”

lines.japanese: イーグルの視界に女が立ちふさがっていた。覚えのある器量だ。
lines.english: A woman stood before Eagle, blocking his path. I knew that face.

lines.japanese: 「どうしよう、本物だ……」
lines.english: “What am I going to do? He's real...”

lines.japanese: 「この子、本物だ！」
lines.english: “This boy is real!”

lines.japanese: るふう、思いだしたぞ。あの女はいずれ賢者王の後宮に召される認識番号００１ではないか。
lines.english: Rufuh. I remembered her now. Was that not Recognition Number 001, the woman destined in time to join the Wise King's harem?

lines.japanese: 「なー、イーグルどうしてるー？」
lines.english: “Hey, what's Eagle doing?”

lines.japanese: 「ふぬん──」
lines.english: “Hrm—”

lines.japanese: 「うう～、貧血のせいで頭が痛い……そうだ、早く家に帰って続きをやらなくちゃ！」
lines.english: “Ugh, my head's killing me from the anemia... Right, I have to hurry home and finish what I started!”

lines.japanese: 「──どうやらホークのふりをしておるようですな。泣き虫ホークが逃げだしたあとの尻拭いと見えます」
lines.english: “—it appears he is impersonating Hawk. Cleaning up the mess the crybaby left when he fled, no doubt.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃっ！　急いで帰るからまた！」
lines.english: “Well, I've gotta hurry home. See you later!”

lines.japanese: 「イーグルめ、００１から逃げたか」
lines.english: “Eagle has fled from 001.”

lines.japanese: 「ばふふん、戦略的撤退はやつの十八番だったな。だがこのガルーダからは逃れられぬぞ。ぶわわっ！」
lines.english: “Bah-hah! A strategic retreat was ever his specialty. But he shall not escape Garuda. Bwahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「ててー？　なんだー、なにおっ始めんだ、かるらー？」
lines.english: “Huh? What's this? What're you starting now, Karura?”

lines.japanese: 「我々の存在を知らしめるため、イーグルの表層意識に強い情念を送ります」
lines.english: “To make him aware of our existence, I shall send a powerful emotion into the surface of Eagle's mind.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー、ムリだでー。おれらの声なんて、ぜってー上のやつらんトコまで届きっこないよ」
lines.english: “Aw, you can't do that. No way our voices could ever reach the guys up there.”

lines.japanese: 「然り、本来ならば容易なことではございません。しかしいまやホークならびにファルコンが地上を捨て、一方我々は奈落を脱している──光と闇の均衡は崩れておるのです」
lines.english: “Indeed, under ordinary circumstances it would be no simple feat. But Hawk and Falcon have now abandoned the surface, while we have escaped the Abyss. The balance between light and darkness has been broken.”

lines.japanese: 『イーグル』
lines.english: “Eagle.”

lines.japanese: 学び舎のただ中で、彼はひとり撃たれたように背筋を伸ばした。
lines.english: There in the midst of his place of learning, his back snapped straight as though he had been shot.

lines.japanese: 『聴こえるか、愚弟イーグル』
lines.english: “Can you hear me, my foolish brother Eagle?”
“Wh—”

lines.japanese: 瞬間的に身をひるがえしたのち、ぎこちなく頭を巡らせて慎重に四顧する。
lines.english: He spun around, then slowly and stiffly turned his head, searching every direction with care.

lines.japanese: 「かるら、どーだあ？」
lines.english: “Karura, how's it going?”

lines.japanese: 「もはは、よう驚いております。多少なりとも届いたようですぞ」
lines.english: “Mohaha! He is wonderfully startled. It appears some portion of my call has reached him.”

lines.japanese: 「まだ言語と呼べるほど明瞭には伝わっておらぬでしょうが、なに、このまま呼びかけつづければ徐々に判然としてくるはず」
lines.english: “It cannot yet be reaching him with the clarity of language. But if I continue to call, the words should gradually take shape.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、カベの向こうでねてるやつを起こすカンジだいね」
lines.english: “Oh, I get it. Like waking somebody who's asleep on the other side of a wall.”

lines.japanese: 内なる気配に慄然としながらも、イーグルは慎重に歩みを再開した。
lines.english: Though the presence within him had left him shaken, Eagle cautiously began to walk again.

lines.japanese: 夕暮れの通廊にひびく自らの足音が、臆病な彼の神経をひどく逆撫でしていると知れた。
lines.english: His own footsteps ringing down the corridor at dusk plainly grated upon his cowardly nerves.

lines.japanese: 私は呪詛を送りつづけた。
lines.english: I continued to send my curse.

lines.japanese: 『去ね』
lines.english: “Begone.”

lines.japanese: 『去ねイーグル。去んで玉座を余に空けよ。その場所は元来、余のものである』
lines.english: “Begone, Eagle. Depart, and leave the throne vacant for me. That place was mine from the beginning.”

lines.japanese: 「なん……なんだ……」
lines.english: “What... What is this...?”

lines.japanese: 『王に玉座を返還し、疾く奈落へ堕ちよ簒奪者』
lines.english: “Return the throne to its king, usurper, and fall with all haste into the Abyss.”

lines.japanese: 「誰だ……誰かいるのか……」
lines.english: “Who are you...? Is somebody there...?”

lines.japanese: 明らかに私の声は漸次イーグルの心を掻きみだしていた。
lines.english: My voice was plainly throwing Eagle's mind into ever greater turmoil.

lines.japanese: 「もははははん、愉快愉快」
lines.english: “Mohahahaha! Most diverting.”

lines.japanese: 「もー、何やってんのー。かるら、おどかしすぎてないかー？」
lines.english: “Come on, what're you doing? Aren't you scaring him too much, Karura?”

lines.japanese: 「当然です。恫喝しておるのですから」
lines.english: “Naturally. I am threatening him.”

lines.japanese: 「かあいそーに、イーグルはオバケとか嫌いな子なんだから、あんましいじめちゃダメでしょー。どーしてかるらは、みんなと仲よくできないのー。おにいちゃん怒るよ」
lines.english: “Poor Eagle. He hates ghosts and stuff, so you shouldn't pick on him so much. Why can't you ever get along with everybody, Karura? Your big brother's gonna get mad.”

lines.japanese: 「おたわむれを。あの者を玉座より引きずり下ろさねば、我らに光はないのですぞ」
lines.english: “Do not jest. Unless we drag that man down from the throne, there will be no light for us.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、ああそっかー。うーん、でもケンカはよくないぞ。なんかいい方法、見っけないーくちゃねえ」
lines.english: “Oh. Oh, right. Hmm... But fighting's still bad. We gotta find a better way.”

lines.japanese: 「おはようございます。千歳ただいま入りました、よろしくお願いします」
lines.english: “Good morning. Shusuke Chitose reporting for duty. I look forward to working with you.”

lines.japanese: 「陛下、イーグルが酒場を訪れました」
lines.english: “Your Majesty, Eagle has entered a tavern.”

lines.japanese: 「あり、なんで。だめでしょー、お酒ぐびぐびのんじゃー。おっかない方のお母さんみたくなっちゃうでー」
lines.english: “Huh? Why? He can't go gulping down booze. He'll wind up like the scary mom.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、どうやら彼は、この店で給仕を務めておるようです」
lines.english: “No. It seems he works as a server in this establishment.”

lines.japanese: 「なあんだ、おしごとかあ。そんじゃしょーがないもんねえ」
lines.english: “Oh, it's his job. Guess that can't be helped.”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　どうした鷲介。そんな、喜び勇んで借りてきたビデオの女優が母親と同じ名前だったときのような顔をして。なにか士気を挫かれるようなことでもあったのか」
lines.english: “Hm? What's wrong, Shusuke? You look like a man who rented an adult video in high spirits, then discovered the actress had the same name as his mother. Has something crushed your morale?”

lines.japanese: 「え……ああいえ、ぜんぜん？　毎度おさわがせしちゃう鷲介ぬるぬるですよ？　今日も今日とて元気ハツラツ──」
lines.english: “What...? Oh, no, not at all! It's the same old slippery Shusuke, causing trouble as always! Bright-eyed and bursting with health, today as ever—”

lines.japanese: 『聴こえるか、愚弟イーグル』
lines.english: “Can you hear me, my foolish brother Eagle?”

lines.japanese: 「鷲介、なんだおい、頭が痛むのか」
lines.english: “Shusuke? What is it? Does your head hurt?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ……なんでも……ちょっと立ちくらみしたもんで、ハハ……失礼します」
lines.english: “No... It's nothing... Just got a little dizzy, ha ha... Excuse me.”

lines.japanese: 『イーグル。すでに自らも勘付いておろう。貴様には未来などない、潔く玉座を渡せ』
lines.english: “Eagle. You have surely begun to realize it yourself. You have no future. Surrender the throne with grace.”

lines.japanese: 「つぅ……なんなんだよ、この声ッ……」
lines.english: “Ngh... What the hell is this voice...”

lines.japanese: 「おうい鷲介、体調が悪いなら無理しないで休んでもいいんだぞう」
lines.english: “Shusuke! If you aren't feeling well, there's no need to push yourself. You can take the day off.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、ちょっと、トイレ、行ってきます……」
lines.english: “N-no, I just... need the bathroom...”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: 「よー、かるら、おまいら兄弟なんだからあんまケンカすんなてー」
lines.english: “Hey, Karura. You're brothers, so don't fight so much.”

lines.japanese: 「ぬるいことを。そうもいきますまい」
lines.english: “Such softness. I fear matters cannot be settled so easily.”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、でもなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm, but still...”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……はぁ……よう、聞こえるかいニューカマー」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... Hey. Can you hear me, newcomer?”

lines.japanese: 「るふん？」
lines.english: “Hrm?”

lines.japanese: 「どうなの……聞こえてんの、いたずら坊主……」
lines.english: “Well...? Can you hear me, you little troublemaker...?”

lines.japanese: 「小賢しい、返答してくるとは。だが存外こちらの声は通っていたのだな。うぉんむ、うぉんむ」
lines.english: “Impudent wretch. He dares answer me. Yet my voice carried more clearly than I expected. Hrrm, hrrm.”

lines.japanese: 『口と芸しか能のない宮廷道化め、いつまでも笑っていられるなどとは考えるなよ。いまや貴様と我らを隔てる壁などその程度の薄さなのだ』
lines.english: “You court jester, fit for nothing but glib words and cheap tricks—do not imagine you shall laugh forever. The wall separating you from us has grown as thin as that.”

lines.japanese: 「はぁ……はぁ……なあ、なんなんだよ……あんまり友好的な波動じゃないみたいだけど、仕事中に勘弁してくれって。誰だいあんた、ボクらの新しい家族？」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... Look, what the hell is this...? You’re not exactly giving off friendly vibes, but could you give me a break while I’m working? Who are you? The newest member of our family?”

lines.japanese: 『愚かな。身の程もわきまえず、下郎が我が尊名を問うか。無知とは罪ぞ』
lines.english: “Fool. A lowly cur ignorant of his station dares ask my exalted name? Ignorance is sin.”

lines.japanese: 「こらあ、かるらー！　そんなイジワルゆったらメーでしょー。名前ぐらいちゃんと教えたげなさいよー？　にいちゃん怒るかんねー」
lines.english: “Hey, Karura! It's a no-no to say mean things like that. At least tell him your name properly, okay? Big Brother's gonna get angry.”

lines.japanese: 『ふぬん、先代国王の命において教えよう。イーグル、下賎にして惰弱な弟よ、心して耳傾けるがよい。余はグレタガルドの王である』
lines.english: “Hrm. At the former king's command, I shall tell you. Eagle, my base and feeble brother, attend closely. I am the King of Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「は……？　なんだって……？」
lines.english: “What...? What did you say...?”

lines.japanese: 『かつての臣民は余をガルーダと呼んでいた。賢者王ガルーダ・ダークブラックだ』
lines.english: “My subjects once called me Garuda. I am the Wise King Garuda Darkblack.”

lines.japanese: 「ガルーダ……？　ハ、なんだいそりゃ、ゲームのキャラじゃないか」
lines.english: “Garuda...? Hah! What the hell? That's a video-game character.”

lines.japanese: 「おはようございます。千歳さん、あの──」
lines.english: “Good morning. Mr. Chitose, I—”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけるなよ……何者なんだ、あんた……」
lines.english: “Don't screw with me... Who are you...?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「……玉泉です。べつにふざけてません」
lines.english: “...I'm Tamaizumi. And I'm not screwing with you.”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　ああ、いやっ、ちちち違うんですよ！」
lines.english: “Ah! No, wait, th-th-that's not what I meant!”

lines.japanese: 「体調が優れないようだと伺ったので、事務室から常備薬を持ってきたんですが──」
lines.english: “I heard you weren't feeling well, so I brought some medicine from the office—”

lines.japanese: 「うそお！　こんなときに限って、鬼の目にも涙！？」
lines.english: “No way! Even the devil can show mercy? Now of all times?!”

lines.japanese: 『どうしたイーグル、早ようその体を明けわたせ。覚悟が定まらぬなら王の手で介錯してやっても良いぞ』
lines.english: “What is the matter, Eagle? Make haste and yield that body. If your resolve should fail you, the king himself may grant you the mercy stroke.”

lines.japanese: 「く……うるさいな、余計なお世話なんだよ……俺の体が欲しいのは分かったから、ちょっと黙ってろって」
lines.english: “Ngh... Shut up. I don't need your help... I get that you want my body, so just keep quiet for a minute.”

lines.japanese: 「そうですか。差しでがましい真似をしてすみません。それでは金輪際話しかけませんので」
lines.english: “I see. I apologize for intruding. Rest assured that I shall never speak to you again as long as I live.”

lines.japanese: 「ああッ！　ちち、ちが、違うんですよ！」
lines.english: “Ah! Th-th-that's not— That's not what I meant!”

lines.japanese: 「っつっても……もう……いませんよね……」
lines.english: “Though... she's already... gone, isn't she...”

lines.japanese: 『下手より退場せよ、道化。喜劇は終わりだ。我が尊名を手土産に、底知れぬ魂の冥府へ還れ』
lines.english: “Exit stage left, jester. The comedy is ended. Take my exalted name as your parting gift and return to the bottomless underworld of souls.”

lines.japanese: 「野郎、それはこっちの台詞だ……世界が平和でありますように……」
lines.english: “Bastard, that’s my line... *May peace prevail on Earth...*”

lines.japanese: 『ふぬん？』
lines.english: “Hrm?”

lines.japanese: 「あんた……あんた、なんてことしてくれたんだ……言っとくけどなあ、あんたなんかより日和子さんのが百倍恐いんだぞ」
lines.english: “You... Do you have any idea what you've done...? Let me tell you, Hiyoko is a hundred times scarier than you.”

lines.japanese: 『まじで！』
lines.english: “Seriously?!”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、さっさと消えなよ、出しゃばり屋さん！　世界が平和でありますように！　世界が平和でありますように！　世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “Oh, just disappear already, you pushy little pest! *May peace prevail on Earth! May peace prevail on Earth! May peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 『ほう、爺々のまじないか。小賢しいな……』
lines.english: “Ah, the old man's incantation. How impertinent...”

lines.japanese: 『まあよい、退いてやろう。どのみち黙っていても貴様はじきに消える。そうなのだろう？』
lines.english: “Very well. I shall withdraw. You will soon disappear even if I remain silent. Is that not so?”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、そうみたいだねえ。でもこうなったら、あんたも道連れにしてやるよ」
lines.english: “Hmph. Seems that way. But if I'm going, I'm taking you with me.”

lines.japanese: 『なんと？』
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「この恨み、決して晴らさでおくべきかッ！　世界が平和でありますように！」
lines.english: “Never shall this grudge go unavenged! *May peace prevail on Earth!*”

lines.japanese: 「ぬふん……」
「かるら、どしたー」
lines.english: “Karura? What's wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「祓われました」
lines.english: “I was exorcised.”

lines.japanese: 「ありゃりゃ」
lines.english: “Oh, dear.”

lines.japanese: 「なにやら憤慨しておったようですが」
lines.english: “He appeared strangely incensed.”

lines.japanese: 「おまいら、ほんと仲わりいなあ」
lines.english: “You guys really don't get along at all.”

lines.japanese: 「他人事のように仰る。御身も弱肉強食の構造内に在ること、ゆめゆめお忘れなさいますなよ。プリンセスダヴをお護りするには、まずあの栄光の玉座を制さねばならんのですからな」
lines.english: “You speak as though this had nothing to do with you. Never forget that you, too, inhabit a world where the strong devour the weak. If we are to protect Princess Dove, we must first seize that glorious throne.”

lines.japanese: 「ううーん、そーなんだよなあ、困ったなあ」
lines.english: “Mmm... Yeah, that's true. What a mess.”
